newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BUX index basket to be revised on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BUX index basket to be revised on Monday.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said the number of companies listed in the BUX index basket will increased to 25 from the current 23 as of September 30.

The BSE will drop agricultural holding company Agrimpex Rt and grocery retailer Global Rt from the basket but add chemical companies TVK and Borsodchem, hotel firm Eravis and packaging firm Cofinec, it said in a statement.
The BSE finalised the basis prices of the new shares today.

Thus the index basket will include Borsodchem, Cofinec, Csopak, Danubius, Domus, Dunaholding, Egis, Eravis, Fotex, Globus, Goldsun, Graboplast, Human, Inter-Europa Bank, MOL, OTP Bank, Pannonplast, Pick, Primagaz, Richter, Skala- Coop T, Styl, TVK, Zalakeramia, and Zwack.
The 25 stocks that will make up the revised BUX index basket accounts for 97 percent for the capitalization of the shares traded or listed on the BSE, the bourse said earlier this month.
